items.title: The comparison diagrams of the qc and Zariski topologies on locally quasi-compact spaces commute with a proper morphism

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes the commutativity of the comparison diagrams for a morphism of LC_qc and, for proper f, the push-pull identity a_Y^{-1}f_* = f_qc,*a_X^{-1} (statement lines 7925-7950). The proof (proof lines 7952-7983) identifies f_qc through relocalisation, derives the two diagrams from the composition of continuous functors and the collected Zariski comparison properties, reduces the push-pull identity to a Zariski statement after applying epsilon_{Y,*}, and quotes part (7a) of the collected statements. H2: one identification and one reduction, written out.
